title: 建築施工階段結構分析
summary: 完工結構的分析假設所有構件同時存在、荷重一次加上，但真實建築是一層層長出來的：混凝土在年輕時就被加載、接頭在不同時間鎖定、支撐被逐步拆除，許多內力在施工中被「鎖入」並留到營運期。本課從一次加載的誤差、施工期風荷載與早齡期材料、接頭狀態與溫差，到由上而下開挖、核心領先、監測回饋、接合前位移監測、鎖入應力與營運中改造，以中央電視台總部、碎片大廈、樂天世界塔與威利斯大樓的公開做法為例。
summaryEn: Analysis of a completed structure assumes all members exist at once and loads arrive in one step, but real buildings grow floor by floor: concrete is loaded young, joints are locked at different times, shores are removed in stages, and many forces are locked in during construction and remain in service. The course moves from the error of one-step loading, construction-period wind and early-age materials, joint states and temperature differences, to top-down excavation, core lead, monitoring feedback, pre-closure movement monitoring, locked-in stresses and alterations in occupied buildings, drawing on public practice at CCTV Headquarters, The Shard, Lotte World Tower and Willis Tower.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢核 7 天齡期樓板在上方新澆樓板與兩層連續支撐下是否安全。板厚 0.25 m，自重 0.25×25 = 6.25 kPa，模板 0.5 kPa，施工活載 1.5 kPa。依 Grundy–Kabaila 類型的分析，多層支撐系統中受載最大的樓板約承受 2.0 倍的（自重 + 模板），需求 = 2.0×6.75 + 1.5 = 15.0 kPa；完工服務荷重為 6.25 + 1.0（附加靜載）+ 2.5（活載）= 9.75 kPa，需求比 15.0/9.75 ≈ 1.54。ACI 209 強度發展 f′c(t)/f′c28 = t/(4 + 0.85t)，7 天約 0.70，衝剪強度隨 √f′c 約為 0.84。若設計服務利用率為 0.45，7 天時等效利用率 = 0.45×1.54/0.84 ≈ 0.83，可以接受；若改在 3 天就承載，強度比 0.46、√ 約 0.68，利用率 ≈ 0.45×1.54/0.68 ≈ 1.02，超過 1.0，必須延後拆撐或增加支撐層數。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check whether a 7-day-old slab is safe under a newly cast slab above with two levels of continuous shoring. The slab is 0.25 m thick, self-weight 0.25×25 = 6.25 kPa, formwork 0.5 kPa and construction live load 1.5 kPa. Grundy–Kabaila-type analysis shows the most heavily loaded slab in a multi-level shoring system carries about 2.0 times (self-weight + formwork), so demand = 2.0×6.75 + 1.5 = 15.0 kPa; the completed service load is 6.25 + 1.0 superimposed dead + 2.5 live = 9.75 kPa, a demand ratio of 15.0/9.75 ≈ 1.54. ACI 209 strength gain is f′c(t)/f′c28 = t/(4 + 0.85t), about 0.70 at 7 days, so punching strength, varying with √f′c, is about 0.84. If the design service utilisation is 0.45, the equivalent utilisation at 7 days is 0.45×1.54/0.84 ≈ 0.83, acceptable; loading at 3 days instead gives a strength ratio of 0.46, √ about 0.68, and utilisation ≈ 0.45×1.54/0.68 ≈ 1.02, above 1.0, so striking must be delayed or more shore levels added. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「一次加載模型的假想內力」與「施工期的臨時狀態荷載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fictitious forces from one-step loading" and "Loads in temporary construction states": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 一次加載模型的假想內力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fictitious forces from one-step loading: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「一次加載與逐層加載」如何影響建築施工階段結構分析的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “One-step versus staged loading” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction-stage structural analysis”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一次加載模型把整棟樓的重力同時施加在完整結構上，柱與核心的縮短從底到頂連續累積，頂部差異最大；但實際施工時，每一層都是在下方已經變形之後才依設計標高施作，早期的縮短已被「歸零」。結果一次加載模型會在高樓層的樓板梁、外伸臂與轉換構件中算出實際上不存在的大內力，而低估中段的內力；在混合系統中甚至會讓內力方向相反。施工階段分析依真實順序逐步啟動構件與荷重，才能得到正確的內力與變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「一次加載與逐層加載」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A one-step model applies the whole building's gravity load to the complete structure at once, so column and core shortening accumulates continuously from bottom to top with the largest difference at the roof; in real construction each floor is built to its design level after the structure below has already deformed, so earlier shortening is reset to zero. A one-step model therefore computes large forces in upper-floor beams, outriggers and transfers that do not exist and underestimates mid-height forces, and in hybrid systems can even reverse their sign. Construction-stage analysis activates members and loads in the real order to obtain correct forces and deformations. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “One-step versus staged loading” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩端固定梁一端相對沉陷 δ 的端彎矩 M = 6EIδ/L²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A fixed-ended beam with relative end settlement δ has end moment M = 6EIδ/L².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要完工狀態的模型正確，施工順序不會影響構件內力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the completed-state model is right, construction sequence does not affect member forces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「一次加載與逐層加載」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “One-step versus staged loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要完工狀態的模型正確，施工順序不會影響構件內力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the completed-state model is right, construction sequence does not affect member forces. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「一次加載模型的假想內力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fictitious forces from one-step loading" is correct?
options: 只要完工狀態的模型正確，施工順序不會影響構件內力。
一次加載模型把整棟樓的重力同時施加在完整結構上，柱與核心的縮短從底到頂連續累積，頂部差異最大。
施工期間的風荷載可以一律打折，因為只是暫時狀態。
optionsEn: If the completed-state model is right, construction sequence does not affect member forces.

A one-step model applies the whole building's gravity load to the complete structure at once, so column and core shortening accumulates continuously from bottom to top with the largest difference at the roof.
Construction-phase wind loads can always be reduced because the state is temporary.
quiz.explanation: 一次加載模型把整棟樓的重力同時施加在完整結構上，柱與核心的縮短從底到頂連續累積，頂部差異最大；但實際施工時，每一層都是在下方已經變形之後才依設計標高施作，早期的縮短已被「歸零」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A one-step model applies the whole building's gravity load to the complete structure at once, so column and core shortening accumulates continuously from bottom to top with the largest difference at the roof; in real construction each floor is built to its design level after the structure below has already deformed, so earlier shortening is reset to zero. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 一次加載模型的假想內力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fictitious forces from one-step loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「一次加載與逐層加載」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “One-step versus staged loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩端固定梁一端相對沉陷 δ 的端彎矩 M = 6EIδ/L²。E = 200 GPa、I = 5×10⁻⁴ m⁴、L = 12 m：若一次加載模型在頂層算出柱與核心差異 δ = 20 mm，M = 6×200×10⁶×5×10⁻⁴×0.020/144 ≈ 83 kN·m；分階段分析顯示頂層差異接近 0，這個彎矩其實是假想的。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A fixed-ended beam with relative end settlement δ has end moment M = 6EIδ/L². With E = 200 GPa, I = 5×10⁻⁴ m⁴ and L = 12 m, a one-step model showing a column–core difference δ = 20 mm at the roof gives M = 6×200×10⁶×5×10⁻⁴×0.020/144 ≈ 83 kN·m; staged analysis shows a difference near zero at the roof, so this moment is fictitious. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時建立一次加載與分階段兩個模型，比較各層樓板梁端彎矩、外伸臂軸力與柱—核心差異縮短的分布，確認差異集中的樓層；再用手算的逐層加載公式抽查一兩個樓層的結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build both a one-step and a staged model and compare beam-end moments, outrigger forces and column–core differential shortening floor by floor to identify where differences concentrate; spot-check one or two floors with a hand storey-by-storey loading formula.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩端固定梁一端相對沉陷 δ 的端彎矩 M = 6EIδ/L²。E = 200 GPa、I = 5×10⁻⁴ m⁴、L = 12 m：若一次加載模型在頂層算出柱與核心差異 δ = 20 mm，M = 6×200×10⁶×5×10⁻⁴×0.020/144 ≈ 83 kN·m；分階段分析顯示頂層差異接近 0，這個彎矩其實是假想的。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A fixed-ended beam with relative end settlement δ has end moment M = 6EIδ/L². With E = 200 GPa, I = 5×10⁻⁴ m⁴ and L = 12 m, a one-step model showing a column–core difference δ = 20 mm at the roof gives M = 6×200×10⁶×5×10⁻⁴×0.020/144 ≈ 83 kN·m; staged analysis shows a difference near zero at the roof, so this moment is fictitious. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「一次加載模型的假想內力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fictitious forces from one-step loading", which statement holds?
options: 兩個結構在任何時間接合，結果都一樣。
核心筒是最堅固的部分，領先多少層都沒有問題。
兩端固定梁一端相對沉陷 δ 的端彎矩 M = 6EIδ/L²。
optionsEn: Joining two structures gives the same result whatever the time of joining.
The core is the strongest element, so it can lead by any number of floors.
A fixed-ended beam with relative end settlement δ has end moment M = 6EIδ/L².
quiz.explanation: 兩端固定梁一端相對沉陷 δ 的端彎矩 M = 6EIδ/L²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A fixed-ended beam with relative end settlement δ has end moment M = 6EIδ/L². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 一次加載模型的假想內力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fictitious forces from one-step loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「一次加載與逐層加載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “One-step versus staged loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時建立一次加載與分階段兩個模型，比較各層樓板梁端彎矩、外伸臂軸力與柱—核心差異縮短的分布，確認差異集中的樓層；再用手算的逐層加載公式抽查一兩個樓層的結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build both a one-step and a staged model and compare beam-end moments, outrigger forces and column–core differential shortening floor by floor to identify where differences concentrate; spot-check one or two floors with a hand storey-by-storey loading formula. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：超過一定高度或含外伸臂、轉換構件的建築，設計規範中應要求提送施工階段分析報告，並由結構工程師說明採用的施工順序、速度與材料時間函數假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For buildings above a set height or with outriggers or transfer structures, require a construction-stage analysis report in which the structural engineer states the assumed sequence, speed and time functions of the materials.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以一次加載結果設計，高樓層連接梁可能被過度加大，中段卻配筋不足而開裂；外伸臂的設計力可能被錯估數倍，導致接頭過大或不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing from one-step results can oversize upper-floor link beams while leaving mid-height ones under-reinforced and cracked, and can misjudge outrigger design forces several-fold, making joints too large or too small. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時建立一次加載與分階段兩個模型，比較各層樓板梁端彎矩、外伸臂軸力與柱—核心差異縮短的分布，確認差異集中的樓層；再用手算的逐層加載公式抽查一兩個樓層的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Build both a one-step and a staged model and compare beam-end moments, outrigger forces and column–core differential shortening floor by floor to identify where differences concentrate; spot-check one or two floors with a hand storey-by-storey loading formula.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 超過一定高度或含外伸臂、轉換構件的建築，設計規範中應要求提送施工階段分析報告，並由結構工程師說明採用的施工順序、速度與材料時間函數假設。
knowledge.textEn: For buildings above a set height or with outriggers or transfer structures, require a construction-stage analysis report in which the structural engineer states the assumed sequence, speed and time functions of the materials.

quiz.question: 要驗證「一次加載模型的假想內力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fictitious forces from one-step loading"?
options: 同時建立一次加載與分階段兩個模型，比較各層樓板梁端彎矩、外伸臂軸力與柱—核心差異縮短的分布，確認差異集中的樓層；再用手算的逐層加載公式抽查一兩個樓層的結果。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
分析模型預測的接合間隙足夠精確，不需要現場監測。
optionsEn: Build both a one-step and a staged model and compare beam-end moments, outrigger forces and column–core differential shortening floor by floor to identify where differences concentrate.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.title: 施工期的臨時狀態荷載：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Return period for construction-phase wind” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction-stage structural analysis”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 施工期的結構和完工狀態不同：外牆尚未封閉、外伸臂還沒鎖定、樓板沒有全部澆置，但同時又承受模板、材料堆放、塔吊與施工活載。EN 1991-1-6 等規範允許依施工期長短採用較短的回歸期風速，因為暴露時間較短；但短回歸期只適用於確實能在期限內完成的狀態，對於會持續一年以上的未完成狀態仍須採用完工設計的回歸期。施工階段分析必須逐一列出這些臨時狀態與其荷載組合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「施工期風荷載回歸期」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The structure during construction differs from the completed one: façades are open, outriggers unlocked and floors partly cast, while formwork, stored material, cranes and construction live loads act on it. Codes such as EN 1991-1-6 allow a shorter return period for wind according to the duration of each phase, because exposure is shorter; the shorter period applies only to states that will genuinely end within that time, and incomplete states lasting more than a year must use the completed-design return period. Construction-stage analysis must list each temporary state with its load combination. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Return period for construction-phase wind” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 施工期的臨時狀態荷載：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Return period for construction-phase wind” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1991-1-4 風速機率修正 c_prob = [(1 − K·ln(−ln(1 − p)))/(1 − K·ln(−ln 0.98))]^n，K = 0.2、n = 0.5。施工期一年內取 10 年回歸期（p = 0.1）：c_prob ≈ 0.902，風壓比 c_prob² ≈ 0.81；3 個月內取 5 年（p = 0.2）：c_prob ≈ 0.855，風壓比 ≈ 0.73。數值為公式示範。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1991-1-4 gives the probability factor c_prob = [(1 − K·ln(−ln(1 − p)))/(1 − K·ln(−ln 0.98))]^n with K = 0.2 and n = 0.5. For a phase within one year using a 10-year return period (p = 0.1), c_prob ≈ 0.902 and the pressure ratio c_prob² ≈ 0.81; for three months using 5 years (p = 0.2), c_prob ≈ 0.855 and the pressure ratio ≈ 0.73. Values illustrate the formula. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工階段分析報告應附臨時狀態清單：每個狀態的持續時間、採用回歸期、外牆封閉程度造成的風壓係數、塔吊與堆料荷重，並說明若工期延誤超過假設時間時的處置方式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The construction-stage report should attach a list of temporary states giving each one's duration, return period used, wind pressure coefficients for the degree of enclosure, crane and storage loads, and what happens if delays extend a state beyond its assumed duration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Return period for construction-phase wind” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工階段分析報告應附臨時狀態清單：每個狀態的持續時間、採用回歸期、外牆封閉程度造成的風壓係數、塔吊與堆料荷重，並說明若工期延誤超過假設時間時的處置方式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The construction-stage report should attach a list of temporary states giving each one's duration, return period used, wind pressure coefficients for the degree of enclosure, crane and storage loads, and what happens if delays extend a state beyond its assumed duration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：臨時狀態的持續時間假設應寫進施工計畫並追蹤；任何延誤使狀態超過假設期間時，由臨時工程設計者重新核算並決定是否補強，這是明確的停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write the assumed duration of each temporary state into the construction plan and track it; whenever delay pushes a state beyond its assumed period, the temporary-works designer must recheck and decide on strengthening, as a defined hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以短回歸期設計某個臨時狀態，但工期延誤使它跨越颱風或冬季風暴季節，實際風荷載可能明顯超過設計，造成臨時支撐或未完成構件破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing a temporary state for a short return period and then letting delays carry it through a typhoon or winter storm season can expose it to wind clearly above its design value and fail temporary bracing or incomplete members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 施工期的臨時狀態荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Loads in temporary construction states: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工期風荷載回歸期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Return period for construction-phase wind” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以短回歸期設計某個臨時狀態，但工期延誤使它跨越颱風或冬季風暴季節，實際風荷載可能明顯超過設計，造成臨時支撐或未完成構件破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing a temporary state for a short return period and then letting delays carry it through a typhoon or winter storm season can expose it to wind clearly above its design value and fail temporary bracing or incomplete members. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工階段分析必須逐一列出這些臨時狀態與其荷載組合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Construction-stage analysis must list each temporary state with its load combination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工期間的風荷載可以一律打折，因為只是暫時狀態。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Construction-phase wind loads can always be reduced because the state is temporary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以短回歸期設計某個臨時狀態，但工期延誤使它跨越颱風或冬季風暴季節，實際風荷載可能明顯超過設計，造成臨時支撐或未完成構件破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Designing a temporary state for a short return period and then letting delays carry it through a typhoon or winter storm season can expose it to wind clearly above its design value and fail temporary bracing or incomplete members.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Loads in temporary construction states" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「材料時間函數：加載齡期與潛變」與「接頭狀態與溫差：兩塔接合」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Material time functions: loading age and creep" and "Joint states and temperature: joining two towers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 材料時間函數：加載齡期與潛變：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Material time functions: loading age and creep: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「早齡期混凝土加載」如何影響建築施工階段結構分析的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Loading young concrete” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction-stage structural analysis”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高樓施工週期常為每三到七天一層，柱與核心牆在混凝土僅數天到數週大時就開始承受上方樓層的荷重。年輕混凝土的模數較低、潛變較大：同樣的應力，早期加載的構件會產生較大的立即變形與長期潛變。施工階段分析因此必須為每一段構件記錄澆置日期與加載時間，以時間函數計算模數與潛變係數，而不是對全樓使用單一的 28 天材料性質。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「早齡期混凝土加載」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tall buildings often rise at one floor every three to seven days, so columns and core walls start carrying the floors above when the concrete is only days or weeks old. Young concrete has a lower modulus and creeps more: under the same stress, members loaded early deform more immediately and creep more over time. Construction-stage analysis must therefore record each segment's casting date and loading time and compute modulus and creep coefficient from time functions, instead of using single 28-day properties for the whole building. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Loading young concrete” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 209 加載齡期修正（濕養護）β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 209's loading-age factor for moist curing is β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土的材料性質用 28 天強度一個數值就足以描述。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single 28-day strength fully describes concrete for analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「早齡期混凝土加載」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Loading young concrete”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 材料時間函數：加載齡期與潛變
knowledge.titleEn: Material time functions: loading age and creep
knowledge.text: 高樓施工週期常為每三到七天一層，柱與核心牆在混凝土僅數天到數週大時就開始承受上方樓層的荷重。年輕混凝土的模數較低、潛變較大：同樣的應力，早期加載的構件會產生較大的立即變形與長期潛變。
knowledge.textEn: Tall buildings often rise at one floor every three to seven days, so columns and core walls start carrying the floors above when the concrete is only days or weeks old. Young concrete has a lower modulus and creeps more: under the same stress, members loaded early deform more immediately and creep more over time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土的材料性質用 28 天強度一個數值就足以描述。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A single 28-day strength fully describes concrete for analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「材料時間函數：加載齡期與潛變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Material time functions: loading age and creep" is correct?
options: 高樓施工週期常為每三到七天一層，柱與核心牆在混凝土僅數天到數週大時就開始承受上方樓層的荷重。
混凝土的材料性質用 28 天強度一個數值就足以描述。
兩個結構在任何時間接合，結果都一樣。
optionsEn: Tall buildings often rise at one floor every three to seven days, so columns and core walls start carrying the floors above when the concrete is only days or weeks old.
A single 28-day strength fully describes concrete for analysis.
Joining two structures gives the same result whatever the time of joining.
quiz.explanation: 高樓施工週期常為每三到七天一層，柱與核心牆在混凝土僅數天到數週大時就開始承受上方樓層的荷重。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tall buildings often rise at one floor every three to seven days, so columns and core walls start carrying the floors above when the concrete is only days or weeks old. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 材料時間函數：加載齡期與潛變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Material time functions: loading age and creep: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「早齡期混凝土加載」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Loading young concrete” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 209 加載齡期修正（濕養護）β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118。t_la = 7 天時 β_la ≈ 0.994，t_la = 28 天時 β_la ≈ 0.844，7 天加載的潛變係數約為 28 天加載的 1.18 倍；3 天加載時 β_la ≈ 1.098，約 1.30 倍。數值為公式示範。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 209's loading-age factor for moist curing is β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118. At t_la = 7 days β_la ≈ 0.994 and at 28 days β_la ≈ 0.844, so loading at 7 days gives a creep coefficient about 1.18 times that of loading at 28 days; loading at 3 days gives β_la ≈ 1.098, about 1.30 times. Values illustrate the formula. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以現場澆置紀錄建立每段構件的齡期資料庫，與分析模型的施工階段對應；以同期養護試體測定早齡期強度與模數，必要時做早齡期加載的潛變試驗，校正模型中的時間函數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build an age database for every member segment from site pour records and map it to the analysis stages; measure early-age strength and modulus on field-cured specimens and, if needed, run creep tests loaded at early age to calibrate the model's time functions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 209 加載齡期修正（濕養護）β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118。t_la = 7 天時 β_la ≈ 0.994，t_la = 28 天時 β_la ≈ 0.844，7 天加載的潛變係數約為 28 天加載的 1.18 倍；3 天加載時 β_la ≈ 1.098，約 1.30 倍。數值為公式示範。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 209's loading-age factor for moist curing is β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118. At t_la = 7 days β_la ≈ 0.994 and at 28 days β_la ≈ 0.844, so loading at 7 days gives a creep coefficient about 1.18 times that of loading at 28 days; loading at 3 days gives β_la ≈ 1.098, about 1.30 times. Values illustrate the formula.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「材料時間函數：加載齡期與潛變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Material time functions: loading age and creep", which statement holds?
options: 核心筒是最堅固的部分，領先多少層都沒有問題。
ACI 209 加載齡期修正（濕養護）β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118。
分析模型預測的接合間隙足夠精確，不需要現場監測。
optionsEn: The core is the strongest element, so it can lead by any number of floors.
ACI 209's loading-age factor for moist curing is β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118.
The closure gap predicted by the analysis model is precise enough without site monitoring.
quiz.explanation: ACI 209 加載齡期修正（濕養護）β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 209's loading-age factor for moist curing is β_la = 1.25·t_la^−0.118. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 材料時間函數：加載齡期與潛變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material time functions: loading age and creep: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「早齡期混凝土加載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Loading young concrete” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以現場澆置紀錄建立每段構件的齡期資料庫，與分析模型的施工階段對應；以同期養護試體測定早齡期強度與模數，必要時做早齡期加載的潛變試驗，校正模型中的時間函數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build an age database for every member segment from site pour records and map it to the analysis stages; measure early-age strength and modulus on field-cured specimens and, if needed, run creep tests loaded at early age to calibrate the model's time functions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工速度變更（例如由每週一層改為每四天一層）須通知結構工程師評估對加載齡期與縮短預測的影響；分析模型應能直接讀入實際澆置日期重算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Any change in construction speed, for example from one floor a week to one every four days, must be reported to the structural engineer to assess the effect on loading age and shortening, and the analysis model should be able to rerun directly from actual pour dates.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若模型以 28 天性質代表全部構件，會低估施工中的變形與潛變，補償值與鎖定時機都會偏差；若施工速度在後期大幅加快，加載齡期變短，實際縮短也會超出原預測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Representing all members with 28-day properties underestimates construction deformations and creep, skewing compensation values and locking times; if construction speeds up greatly later, loading ages shorten and real shortening exceeds the original prediction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以現場澆置紀錄建立每段構件的齡期資料庫，與分析模型的施工階段對應；以同期養護試體測定早齡期強度與模數，必要時做早齡期加載的潛變試驗，校正模型中的時間函數。
knowledge.textEn: Build an age database for every member segment from site pour records and map it to the analysis stages; measure early-age strength and modulus on field-cured specimens and, if needed, run creep tests loaded at early age to calibrate the model's time functions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工速度變更（例如由每週一層改為每四天一層）須通知結構工程師評估對加載齡期與縮短預測的影響；分析模型應能直接讀入實際澆置日期重算。
knowledge.textEn: Any change in construction speed, for example from one floor a week to one every four days, must be reported to the structural engineer to assess the effect on loading age and shortening, and the analysis model should be able to rerun directly from actual pour dates.

quiz.question: 要驗證「材料時間函數：加載齡期與潛變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Material time functions: loading age and creep"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.instruction: 若模型以 28 天性質代表全部構件，會低估施工中的變形與潛變，補償值與鎖定時機都會偏差；若施工速度在後期大幅加快，加載齡期變短，實際縮短也會超出原預測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 接頭狀態與溫差：兩塔接合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint states and temperature: joining two towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「接合時的兩塔溫差」如何影響建築施工階段結構分析的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temperature difference at tower closure” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction-stage structural analysis”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 施工階段分析中，同一個接頭在不同階段可能是開放、鉸接或剛接。最極端的例子是兩棟獨立塔樓在高處接合：接合前兩塔各自受日照、風與重力而移動，接合後它們變成一個連續結構，接合瞬間的相對位移與溫度差會被永久鎖入。Arup 說明中央電視台總部兩座傾斜塔樓在早晨約 8 點、鋼材溫度最均勻時接合，接合前監測了五天的整體與相對位移，並在安裝前最後調整連接構件長度，接合必須在幾分鐘內完成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「接合時的兩塔溫差」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In construction-stage analysis the same joint may be open, pinned or rigid at different stages. The extreme case is two separate towers joined high up: before closure each tower moves under sun, wind and gravity, and after closure they act as one continuous structure, permanently locking in the relative displacement and temperature difference at the moment of joining. Arup explains that the two leaning towers of CCTV Headquarters were joined at about 8 am when the steel was at its most uniform temperature, after five days of monitoring global and relative movements, with final adjustment of the link members' length before installation and the connection made within minutes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temperature difference at tower closure” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫差造成的長度差 ΔL = αLΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Temperature-induced length difference is ΔL = αLΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個結構在任何時間接合，結果都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joining two structures gives the same result whatever the time of joining." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「接合時的兩塔溫差」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 接頭狀態與溫差：兩塔接合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint states and temperature: joining two towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接合時的兩塔溫差」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temperature difference at tower closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫差造成的長度差 ΔL = αLΔT。塔高 L = 160 m、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C：受日照一側與背陰一側溫差 ΔT = 10 °C 時 ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×160,000×10 ≈ 19.2 mm；若在午後溫差最大時接合，這 19.2 mm 會被鎖入連接構件，夜間冷卻後轉成拉壓力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Temperature-induced length difference is ΔL = αLΔT. For towers L = 160 m tall with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 10 °C difference between sunlit and shaded sides gives ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×160,000×10 ≈ 19.2 mm; joining in the afternoon at maximum difference would lock these 19.2 mm into the link members, becoming tension or compression as they cool at night. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：接合前連續數日以全站儀或衛星定位監測兩塔頂部與接合點的三維位移，同步記錄鋼材溫度，建立位移與溫度的關係，找出溫度最均勻的時段；以分析模型預測該時段的間隙，並決定連接構件的最終長度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For several days before closure, monitor three-dimensional movements of both tower tops and the joint with total stations or satellite positioning while logging steel temperatures, establish the movement–temperature relationship and identify when temperatures are most uniform; use the analysis model to predict the gap at that time and set the final length of the link members.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 接合前連續數日以全站儀或衛星定位監測兩塔頂部與接合點的三維位移，同步記錄鋼材溫度，建立位移與溫度的關係，找出溫度最均勻的時段；以分析模型預測該時段的間隙，並決定連接構件的最終長度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Major closures need a dedicated closure plan defining the monitoring period, permissible temperature and movement window, adjustment range of link members, maximum working time and abort criteria, executed only after on-site confirmation by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在溫差大的時段強行接合，或連接構件長度沒有依實測調整，鎖入的附加力可能使連接構件或其接頭在第一個冬季或夏季就達到設計容量，甚至開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forcing closure when temperature differences are large, or failing to adjust link lengths to measurements, can lock in additional forces that bring the link members or their joints to design capacity, or crack them, in the first winter or summer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staged earth pressure in top-down excavation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction-stage structural analysis”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 地下室開挖是最典型的施工階段問題：擋土牆在每個開挖深度下的受力與變形都不同，支撐（臨時支撐或已完成的樓板）加入的時間決定了牆體在後續階段的彎矩分布。碎片大廈採用由上而下施工，以地下室樓板作為擋土牆的剛性支撐，同時讓核心筒向上施作，設計者並以有限元素分析預測鄰近基礎設施的位移。分析必須逐階段開挖、逐階段加入支撐，並把牆體在前一階段已發生的變形帶入下一階段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「由上而下開挖的分階段土壓」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 地下開挖的分階段分析：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「由上而下開挖的分階段土壓」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Staged earth pressure in top-down excavation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三角形土壓合力 P = ½Kγ H²。K = 0.5、γ = 20 kN/m³：開挖到 H = 6 m 時 P = 0.5×0.5×20×36 = 180 kN/m；若支撐尚未加入就挖到 H = 12 m，P = 720 kN/m，為 4 倍，且牆體懸臂彎矩隨 H³ 增加約 8 倍。數值為教學假設，未計水壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The resultant of triangular earth pressure is P = ½Kγ H². With K = 0.5 and γ = 20 kN/m³, excavating to H = 6 m gives P = 0.5×0.5×20×36 = 180 kN/m; digging to H = 12 m before the next prop gives P = 720 kN/m, four times as much, and the wall's cantilever moment grows with H³, about eight times. Values are teaching assumptions excluding water pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個開挖階段結束時比較擋土牆傾斜管實測變形與分析預測，並量測支撐軸力（應變計或荷重計）；任一階段的實測超過預測的警戒比例時，暫停下一階段開挖並由大地與結構工程師重新評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At the end of each excavation stage compare inclinometer deflections of the wall with the analysis and measure prop forces with strain gauges or load cells; if any stage exceeds the warning fraction of the prediction, stop the next stage until geotechnical and structural engineers reassess.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The base moment of the leading segment is M = wL²/2. Values are teaching assumptions excluding form and crane loads. steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List the maximum permitted lead in the construction plan and confirm the actual lead before every climb; check wall stresses and coupling-beam shear in the leading segment under construction-phase wind with the staged model, adding temporary struts inside the lead or accelerating floors if needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「核心領先樓板時的臨時穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temporary stability while the core leads" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若鋼構或樓板因供料延誤而落後，核心領先距離不斷擴大卻沒有人重新檢核，強風時領先段牆體可能開裂或爬模錨定失效，嚴重時危及爬模平台上的人員。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
全站儀量到的座標就是結構的真實永久位置。
optionsEn: If steel or slab work falls behind because of supply delays and the lead keeps growing without a recheck, a strong wind can crack the leading walls or fail the form anchors, endangering workers on the climbing platform.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Coordinates read by a total station are the structure's true permanent position.
quiz.explanation: 若鋼構或樓板因供料延誤而落後，核心領先距離不斷擴大卻沒有人重新檢核，強風時領先段牆體可能開裂或爬模錨定失效，嚴重時危及爬模平台上的人員。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If steel or slab work falls behind because of supply delays and the lead keeps growing without a recheck, a strong wind can crack the leading walls or fail the form anchors, endangering workers on the climbing platform. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工測量的溫度效應修正」與「以監測資料決定接合條件」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Temperature correction of construction surveys" and "Setting closure conditions from monitoring data": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工測量的溫度效應修正：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature correction of construction surveys: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「日照熱彎曲修正」如何影響建築施工階段結構分析的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Correction for solar thermal bowing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction-stage structural analysis”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高樓在日照下一側受熱伸長、背陰側較冷，整棟樓會像雙金屬片一樣彎向背陰側，頂部在一天中的水平移動可達數十毫米。施工中以測量控制核心筒垂直度與樓板座標時，若在日照強烈時放樣，量到的是被熱彎曲扭曲的位置；施工階段分析的預測值則多半不含日照效應。因此測量與分析比對時必須在一致的溫度條件下（例如清晨）讀數，或以溫度量測修正。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「日照熱彎曲修正」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under sunshine one side of a tower heats and lengthens while the shaded side stays cooler, so the building bows toward the shade like a bimetallic strip, and the top can move tens of millimetres horizontally during the day. If core verticality and floor coordinates are set out during strong sunshine, the survey records a position distorted by thermal bowing, while construction-stage predictions usually exclude solar effects. Surveys must therefore be compared with analysis under consistent temperature conditions, for example at dawn, or corrected using temperature measurements. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Correction for solar thermal bowing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫差造成的曲率 κ = αΔT/B，懸臂頂部位移 Δ = κH²/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Temperature difference produces curvature κ = αΔT/B and a cantilever top displacement Δ = κH²/2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全站儀量到的座標就是結構的真實永久位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Coordinates read by a total station are the structure's true permanent position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「日照熱彎曲修正」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Correction for solar thermal bowing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：全站儀量到的座標就是結構的真實永久位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「施工測量的溫度效應修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

quiz.explanationEn: Under sunshine one side of a tower heats and lengthens while the shaded side stays cooler, so the building bows toward the shade like a bimetallic strip, and the top can move tens of millimetres horizontally during the day. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工測量的溫度效應修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature correction of construction surveys: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「日照熱彎曲修正」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Correction for solar thermal bowing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫差造成的曲率 κ = αΔT/B，懸臂頂部位移 Δ = κH²/2。α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、兩側溫差 ΔT = 15 °C、寬 B = 30 m：κ = 6.0×10⁻⁶ /m；H = 150 m 時 Δ = 6.0×10⁻⁶×150²/2 ≈ 67.5 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Temperature difference produces curvature κ = αΔT/B and a cantilever top displacement Δ = κH²/2. With α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, ΔT = 15 °C between faces and width B = 30 m, κ = 6.0×10⁻⁶ /m, so at H = 150 m Δ = 6.0×10⁻⁶×150²/2 ≈ 67.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在核心牆兩側埋設溫度計，在施工期間定時記錄；控制性測量安排在日出前後溫度最均勻時進行，或同時讀取溫度並依熱彎曲公式修正；以連續數日的測量建立溫度—位移關係，檢驗修正方法。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Embed thermometers on opposite faces of the core and log them regularly; schedule control surveys around sunrise when temperatures are most uniform, or read temperatures simultaneously and correct with the bowing formula; establish the temperature–displacement relationship over several days to validate the correction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 溫差造成的曲率 κ = αΔT/B，懸臂頂部位移 Δ = κH²/2。α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、兩側溫差 ΔT = 15 °C、寬 B = 30 m：κ = 6.0×10⁻⁶ /m；H = 150 m 時 Δ = 6.0×10⁻⁶×150²/2 ≈ 67.5 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature difference produces curvature κ = αΔT/B and a cantilever top displacement Δ = κH²/2. With α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, ΔT = 15 °C between faces and width B = 30 m, κ = 6.0×10⁻⁶ /m, so at H = 150 m Δ = 6.0×10⁻⁶×150²/2 ≈ 67.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工測量的溫度效應修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature correction of construction surveys", which statement holds?
options: 既有建築的基礎容量固定不變，只能依原設計值使用。
施工期間的風荷載可以一律打折，因為只是暫時狀態。
溫差造成的曲率 κ = αΔT/B，懸臂頂部位移 Δ = κH²/2。
optionsEn: An existing building's foundation capacity is fixed at its original design value.
Construction-phase wind loads can always be reduced because the state is temporary.
Temperature difference produces curvature κ = αΔT/B and a cantilever top displacement Δ = κH²/2.
quiz.explanation: 溫差造成的曲率 κ = αΔT/B，懸臂頂部位移 Δ = κH²/2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature difference produces curvature κ = αΔT/B and a cantilever top displacement Δ = κH²/2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工測量的溫度效應修正：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature correction of construction surveys: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「日照熱彎曲修正」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Correction for solar thermal bowing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在核心牆兩側埋設溫度計，在施工期間定時記錄；控制性測量安排在日出前後溫度最均勻時進行，或同時讀取溫度並依熱彎曲公式修正；以連續數日的測量建立溫度—位移關係，檢驗修正方法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Embed thermometers on opposite faces of the core and log them regularly; schedule control surveys around sunrise when temperatures are most uniform, or read temperatures simultaneously and correct with the bowing formula; establish the temperature–displacement relationship over several days to validate the correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：測量規範應規定控制測量的時段、溫度記錄方式與修正程序，並要求測量團隊把讀數時間與溫度一併交給結構工程師，供與施工階段分析比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The survey specification should fix control-survey times, temperature recording and correction procedures, and require surveyors to pass reading times and temperatures to the structural engineer for comparison with the construction-stage analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在午後放樣並以此修正核心筒的「傾斜」，等於把可逆的熱彎曲當成永久偏差而去補償，結果在夜間核心反而偏向另一側，誤差逐層累積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting out in the afternoon and correcting the core's apparent lean treats reversible thermal bowing as a permanent error; at night the core then leans the other way and the error accumulates floor by floor. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在核心牆兩側埋設溫度計，在施工期間定時記錄；控制性測量安排在日出前後溫度最均勻時進行，或同時讀取溫度並依熱彎曲公式修正；以連續數日的測量建立溫度—位移關係，檢驗修正方法。
knowledge.textEn: Embed thermometers on opposite faces of the core and log them regularly; schedule control surveys around sunrise when temperatures are most uniform, or read temperatures simultaneously and correct with the bowing formula; establish the temperature–displacement relationship over several days to validate the correction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 測量規範應規定控制測量的時段、溫度記錄方式與修正程序，並要求測量團隊把讀數時間與溫度一併交給結構工程師，供與施工階段分析比較。
knowledge.textEn: The survey specification should fix control-survey times, temperature recording and correction procedures, and require surveyors to pass reading times and temperatures to the structural engineer for comparison with the construction-stage analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工測量的溫度效應修正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature correction of construction surveys"?
options: 在核心牆兩側埋設溫度計，在施工期間定時記錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩個結構在任何時間接合，結果都一樣。
optionsEn: Embed thermometers on opposite faces of the core and log them regularly.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Joining two structures gives the same result whatever the time of joining.
quiz.explanation: 在核心牆兩側埋設溫度計，在施工期間定時記錄；控制性測量安排在日出前後溫度最均勻時進行，或同時讀取溫度並依熱彎曲公式修正；以連續數日的測量建立溫度—位移關係，檢驗修正方法。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Embed thermometers on opposite faces of the core and log them regularly; schedule control surveys around sunrise when temperatures are most uniform, or read temperatures simultaneously and correct with the bowing formula; establish the temperature–displacement relationship over several days to validate the correction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工測量的溫度效應修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature correction of construction surveys: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「日照熱彎曲修正」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Correction for solar thermal bowing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在午後放樣並以此修正核心筒的「傾斜」，等於把可逆的熱彎曲當成永久偏差而去補償，結果在夜間核心反而偏向另一側，誤差逐層累積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting out in the afternoon and correcting the core's apparent lean treats reversible thermal bowing as a permanent error; at night the core then leans the other way and the error accumulates floor by floor. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此測量與分析比對時必須在一致的溫度條件下（例如清晨）讀數，或以溫度量測修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surveys must therefore be compared with analysis under consistent temperature conditions, for example at dawn, or corrected using temperature measurements.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「施工測量的溫度效應修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature correction of construction surveys" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若在午後放樣並以此修正核心筒的「傾斜」，等於把可逆的熱彎曲當成永久偏差而去補償，結果在夜間核心反而偏向另一側，誤差逐層累積。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Setting out in the afternoon and correcting the core's apparent lean treats reversible thermal bowing as a permanent error.
The closure gap predicted by the analysis model is precise enough without site monitoring.
quiz.explanation: 若在午後放樣並以此修正核心筒的「傾斜」，等於把可逆的熱彎曲當成永久偏差而去補償，結果在夜間核心反而偏向另一側，誤差逐層累積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting out in the afternoon and correcting the core's apparent lean treats reversible thermal bowing as a permanent error; at night the core then leans the other way and the error accumulates floor by floor. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 以監測資料決定接合條件：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Setting closure conditions from monitoring data: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「接合前位移監測窗口」如何影響建築施工階段結構分析的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pre-closure movement window” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction-stage structural analysis”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 施工階段分析能預測接合時的間隙，但真實結構的溫度、風與施工荷重都在變動，所以接合條件最終要由監測資料決定。做法是在接合前連續數日量測間隙與溫度，統計間隙在預定時段的平均值與變異，再與連接構件的可調範圍比較；只有當變異在可調範圍內，才能保證在作業窗口內完成接合而不鎖入過大的力。中央電視台總部在接合前即進行了五天的位移監測，並在安裝前最後調整構件長度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「接合前位移監測窗口」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Construction-stage analysis predicts the gap at closure, but real temperature, wind and construction loads keep changing, so closure conditions must ultimately come from monitoring data. Gaps and temperatures are measured continuously for several days, the mean and scatter of the gap during the planned window are computed and compared with the adjustment range of the link members; only if the scatter fits within that range can closure be completed in the window without locking in excessive force. At CCTV Headquarters five days of movement monitoring preceded the closure, with final adjustment of member lengths before installation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pre-closure movement window” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 ±2σ 估算接合時段間隙變化：若五天清晨時段實測間隙平均 42 mm、標準差 σ = 4 mm，則 95% 範圍約 42 ± 8 mm（34 至 50 mm）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate the gap variation in the closure window as ±2σ: if five days of dawn readings average 42 mm with standard deviation σ = 4 mm, the 95% range is about 42 ± 8 mm (34 to 50 mm).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分析模型預測的接合間隙足夠精確，不需要現場監測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The closure gap predicted by the analysis model is precise enough without site monitoring." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「接合前位移監測窗口」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pre-closure movement window”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 以監測資料決定接合條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Setting closure conditions from monitoring data: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接合前位移監測窗口」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pre-closure movement window” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 ±2σ 估算接合時段間隙變化：若五天清晨時段實測間隙平均 42 mm、標準差 σ = 4 mm，則 95% 範圍約 42 ± 8 mm（34 至 50 mm）。連接構件可調範圍 ±10 mm 時可涵蓋；若 σ 增為 6 mm，±12 mm 已超出，需要縮短作業窗口或改在更穩定的時段。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate the gap variation in the closure window as ±2σ: if five days of dawn readings average 42 mm with standard deviation σ = 4 mm, the 95% range is about 42 ± 8 mm (34 to 50 mm). A link adjustment range of ±10 mm covers it; if σ grows to 6 mm, ±12 mm exceeds it, so the window must be shortened or moved to a more stable period. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：監測報告須列出每日間隙、溫度、風速與施工荷重狀態，計算預定時段的統計值並與分析預測比較；接合當天再以即時量測確認間隙落在允許範圍內，記錄實際接合時間、溫度與構件最終長度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The monitoring report must list daily gaps, temperatures, wind speed and construction-load state, compute statistics for the planned window and compare with analysis predictions; on closure day confirm by live measurement that the gap is within limits and record the actual time, temperature and final member lengths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 以監測資料決定接合條件：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接合前位移監測窗口」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 監測報告須列出每日間隙、溫度、風速與施工荷重狀態，計算預定時段的統計值並與分析預測比較；接合當天再以即時量測確認間隙落在允許範圍內，記錄實際接合時間、溫度與構件最終長度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依分析預測決定構件長度而不做監測，實際間隙偏離時只能以強制拉合或切割補焊處理，前者鎖入大力，後者在高空增加焊接缺陷風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting member lengths from analysis alone without monitoring leaves only forced pulling or cutting and re-welding if the real gap differs; the first locks in large forces and the second adds weld-defect risk at height. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鎖入應力的記錄與交接」與「營運中建築改造的施工階段分析」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Recording and handing over locked-in stresses" and "Construction-stage analysis for alterations in occupied buildings": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鎖入應力的記錄與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Recording and handing over locked-in stresses: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「非複合與複合階段的鎖入應力」如何影響建築施工階段結構分析的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Locked-in stress from non-composite and composite stages” governs force, deformation or durability in “Construction-stage structural analysis”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 許多構件在施工中經歷不同的結構狀態：鋼梁先獨自承受濕混凝土，混凝土硬化後才與樓板形成複合斷面承受後加荷重；支撐拆除的順序也決定荷重由誰承擔。各階段的應力會疊加並保留下來，這就是鎖入應力。若營運期改造只用完工後的複合斷面重新分析，會低估既有應力。樂天世界塔的設計者延後外伸臂最終接合、威利斯大樓改造時以三維模型規劃拆除順序，都是在管理鎖入狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「非複合與複合階段的鎖入應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Many members pass through different structural states during construction: a steel beam first carries wet concrete alone, and only after hardening does it act compositely with the slab for later loads, while the order of shore removal decides which members pick up load. Stresses from each stage add up and remain, which is locked-in stress. If a later alteration re-analyses only the completed composite section, existing stresses are underestimated. Delaying the final outrigger connections at Lotte World Tower and planning the demolition sequence with a three-dimensional model at Willis Tower are both ways of managing locked-in states. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Locked-in stress from non-composite and composite stages” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鋼梁 L = 15 m：施工階段濕混凝土 w₁ = 20 kN/m 由鋼斷面承受，M₁ = 562.5 kN·m，S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₁ = 187.5 MPa；複合後加荷重 w₂ = 15 kN/m，M₂ ≈ 421.9 kN·m，S_c = 5.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₂ ≈ 84.4 MPa；合計約 271.9 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 15 m steel beam, wet concrete w₁ = 20 kN/m on the bare steel gives M₁ = 562.5 kN·m and, with S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³, σ₁ = 187.5 MPa; later load w₂ = 15 kN/m on the composite section gives M₂ ≈ 421.9 kN·m and, with S_c = 5.0×10⁻³ m³, σ₂ ≈ 84.4 MPa, about 271.9 MPa in total.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完工後的結構內力只取決於最終幾何與荷重，與施工過程無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Forces in a completed structure depend only on final geometry and loads, not on how it was built." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「非複合與複合階段的鎖入應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Locked-in stress from non-composite and composite stages”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Stresses from each stage add up and remain, which is locked-in stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完工後的結構內力只取決於最終幾何與荷重，與施工過程無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「鎖入應力的記錄與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Recording and handing over locked-in stresses" is correct?
options: 許多構件在施工中經歷不同的結構狀態：鋼梁先獨自承受濕混凝土，混凝土硬化後才與樓板形成複合斷面承受後加荷重；支撐拆除的順序也決定荷重由誰承擔。
完工後的結構內力只取決於最終幾何與荷重，與施工過程無關。
既有建築的基礎容量固定不變，只能依原設計值使用。
optionsEn: Many members pass through different structural states during construction: a steel beam first carries wet concrete alone, and only after hardening does it act compositely with the slab for later loads, while the order of shore removal decides which members pick up load.
Forces in a completed structure depend only on final geometry and loads, not on how it was built.
An existing building's foundation capacity is fixed at its original design value.
quiz.explanation: 許多構件在施工中經歷不同的結構狀態：鋼梁先獨自承受濕混凝土，混凝土硬化後才與樓板形成複合斷面承受後加荷重；支撐拆除的順序也決定荷重由誰承擔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Many members pass through different structural states during construction: a steel beam first carries wet concrete alone, and only after hardening does it act compositely with the slab for later loads, while the order of shore removal decides which members pick up load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鎖入應力的記錄與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Recording and handing over locked-in stresses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非複合與複合階段的鎖入應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Locked-in stress from non-composite and composite stages” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋼梁 L = 15 m：施工階段濕混凝土 w₁ = 20 kN/m 由鋼斷面承受，M₁ = 562.5 kN·m，S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₁ = 187.5 MPa；複合後加荷重 w₂ = 15 kN/m，M₂ ≈ 421.9 kN·m，S_c = 5.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₂ ≈ 84.4 MPa；合計約 271.9 MPa。若一次以複合斷面計算，σ = 984.4/5.0×10⁻³ ≈ 196.9 MPa，低估約 28%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 15 m steel beam, wet concrete w₁ = 20 kN/m on the bare steel gives M₁ = 562.5 kN·m and, with S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³, σ₁ = 187.5 MPa; later load w₂ = 15 kN/m on the composite section gives M₂ ≈ 421.9 kN·m and, with S_c = 5.0×10⁻³ m³, σ₂ ≈ 84.4 MPa, about 271.9 MPa in total. A single composite analysis gives σ = 984.4/5.0×10⁻³ ≈ 196.9 MPa, about 28% low. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工階段分析輸出關鍵構件在每個階段結束時的內力與應力，形成鎖入應力表；施工中以應變計抽查代表性構件，確認實測應力增量與各階段預測一致，並把最終鎖入狀態寫入竣工結構報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Have the construction-stage analysis output forces and stresses in key members at the end of each stage as a locked-in stress table; spot-check representative members with strain gauges during construction to confirm measured increments match stage predictions, and write the final locked-in state into the as-built structural report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 鋼梁 L = 15 m：施工階段濕混凝土 w₁ = 20 kN/m 由鋼斷面承受，M₁ = 562.5 kN·m，S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₁ = 187.5 MPa；複合後加荷重 w₂ = 15 kN/m，M₂ ≈ 421.9 kN·m，S_c = 5.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₂ ≈ 84.4 MPa；合計約 271.9 MPa。若一次以複合斷面計算，σ = 984.4/5.0×10⁻³ ≈ 196.9 MPa，低估約 28%。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鎖入應力的記錄與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Recording and handing over locked-in stresses", which statement holds?
options: 施工期間的風荷載可以一律打折，因為只是暫時狀態。
鋼梁 L = 15 m：施工階段濕混凝土 w₁ = 20 kN/m 由鋼斷面承受，M₁ = 562.5 kN·m，S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₁ = 187.5 MPa。
兩個結構在任何時間接合，結果都一樣。
optionsEn: Construction-phase wind loads can always be reduced because the state is temporary.
For a 15 m steel beam, wet concrete w₁ = 20 kN/m on the bare steel gives M₁ = 562.5 kN·m and, with S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³, σ₁ = 187.5 MPa.
Joining two structures gives the same result whatever the time of joining.
quiz.explanation: 鋼梁 L = 15 m：施工階段濕混凝土 w₁ = 20 kN/m 由鋼斷面承受，M₁ = 562.5 kN·m，S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₁ = 187.5 MPa；複合後加荷重 w₂ = 15 kN/m，M₂ ≈ 421.9 kN·m，S_c = 5.0×10⁻³ m³，σ₂ ≈ 84.4 MPa；合計約 271.9 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 15 m steel beam, wet concrete w₁ = 20 kN/m on the bare steel gives M₁ = 562.5 kN·m and, with S_s = 3.0×10⁻³ m³, σ₁ = 187.5 MPa; later load w₂ = 15 kN/m on the composite section gives M₂ ≈ 421.9 kN·m and, with S_c = 5.0×10⁻³ m³, σ₂ ≈ 84.4 MPa, about 271.9 MPa in total. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鎖入應力的記錄與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Recording and handing over locked-in stresses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「非複合與複合階段的鎖入應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Locked-in stress from non-composite and composite stages” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工階段分析輸出關鍵構件在每個階段結束時的內力與應力，形成鎖入應力表；施工中以應變計抽查代表性構件，確認實測應力增量與各階段預測一致，並把最終鎖入狀態寫入竣工結構報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Have the construction-stage analysis output forces and stresses in key members at the end of each stage as a locked-in stress table; spot-check representative members with strain gauges during construction to confirm measured increments match stage predictions, and write the final locked-in state into the as-built structural report. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工交接時附上施工階段分析的最終模型、鎖入應力表、支撐拆除與接頭鎖定紀錄；日後任何改造評估都必須以此為起點，而不是重新建立一次加載模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover include the final construction-stage model, the locked-in stress table and records of shore removal and joint locking; any later alteration assessment must start from these rather than from a new one-step model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改造時若不知道某根梁在施工階段已以鋼斷面承受大部分自重，以複合斷面判斷仍有餘裕而增加荷重，實際應力可能超過降伏；轉換構件或外伸臂的鎖入力被忽略時，局部切割可能引發突然的力量重分配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If renovators do not know a beam carried most of its self-weight on the bare steel during construction and add load because the composite section seems to have margin, real stress may exceed yield; ignoring locked-in forces in transfers or outriggers can trigger sudden redistribution when part is cut. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工階段分析輸出關鍵構件在每個階段結束時的內力與應力，形成鎖入應力表；施工中以應變計抽查代表性構件，確認實測應力增量與各階段預測一致，並把最終鎖入狀態寫入竣工結構報告。
knowledge.textEn: Have the construction-stage analysis output forces and stresses in key members at the end of each stage as a locked-in stress table; spot-check representative members with strain gauges during construction to confirm measured increments match stage predictions, and write the final locked-in state into the as-built structural report.

knowledge.text: 竣工交接時附上施工階段分析的最終模型、鎖入應力表、支撐拆除與接頭鎖定紀錄；日後任何改造評估都必須以此為起點，而不是重新建立一次加載模型。
knowledge.textEn: At handover include the final construction-stage model, the locked-in stress table and records of shore removal and joint locking; any later alteration assessment must start from these rather than from a new one-step model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鎖入應力的記錄與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Recording and handing over locked-in stresses"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
核心筒是最堅固的部分，領先多少層都沒有問題。
施工階段分析輸出關鍵構件在每個階段結束時的內力與應力，形成鎖入應力表。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The core is the strongest element, so it can lead by any number of floors.
Have the construction-stage analysis output forces and stresses in key members at the end of each stage as a locked-in stress table.
quiz.explanation: 施工階段分析輸出關鍵構件在每個階段結束時的內力與應力，形成鎖入應力表；施工中以應變計抽查代表性構件，確認實測應力增量與各階段預測一致，並把最終鎖入狀態寫入竣工結構報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Have the construction-stage analysis output forces and stresses in key members at the end of each stage as a locked-in stress table; spot-check representative members with strain gauges during construction to confirm measured increments match stage predictions, and write the final locked-in state into the as-built structural report. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鎖入應力的記錄與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Recording and handing over locked-in stresses: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非複合與複合階段的鎖入應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Locked-in stress from non-composite and composite stages” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改造時若不知道某根梁在施工階段已以鋼斷面承受大部分自重，以複合斷面判斷仍有餘裕而增加荷重，實際應力可能超過降伏；轉換構件或外伸臂的鎖入力被忽略時，局部切割可能引發突然的力量重分配。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If renovators do not know a beam carried most of its self-weight on the bare steel during construction and add load because the composite section seems to have margin, real stress may exceed yield; ignoring locked-in forces in transfers or outriggers can trigger sudden redistribution when part is cut. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：樂天世界塔的設計者延後外伸臂最終接合、威利斯大樓改造時以三維模型規劃拆除順序，都是在管理鎖入狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Delaying the final outrigger connections at Lotte World Tower and planning the demolition sequence with a three-dimensional model at Willis Tower are both ways of managing locked-in states.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完工後的結構內力只取決於最終幾何與荷重，與施工過程無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 營運中建築改造的施工階段分析：機制與傳力路徑

steps.instruction: 既有建築的改造同樣是施工階段問題，而且限制更多：結構一直在使用、荷重不能卸除、既有構件與基礎的容量需重新確認。Thornton Tomasetti 在威利斯大樓底座改造中以迭代工具追蹤哪些既有沉箱已接近容量、哪些還能承受更多，並透過土壤試驗與鑽穿既有沉箱，確認建物四十多年加壓後的土層提供了所需的額外承載，最終不需新增基礎；同時規劃臨時支撐、拆除與施作順序，讓大樓全程營運。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「營運中改造的既有基礎容量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：既有沉箱利用率 = (既有荷重 + 新增荷重)/容量。既有 15.5 MN、新增 3.2 MN、原容量 20 MN：利用率 = 18.7/20 ≈ 93.5%；若試驗證實土層壓密使容量提高到 22 MN，利用率降為 18.7/22 ≈ 85%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Existing caisson utilisation = (existing load + added load)/capacity. With 15.5 MN existing, 3.2 MN added and an original capacity of 20 MN, utilisation = 18.7/20 ≈ 93.5%; if tests confirm that soil densification raises capacity to 22 MN, utilisation falls to 18.7/22 ≈ 85%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以竣工圖、現場量測與材料試驗重建既有結構模型，逐一列出受影響基礎與構件的既有荷重、新增荷重與容量；每個施工步驟（拆除、臨時支撐、新增荷重）都在模型中模擬並量測關鍵柱的應變與沉陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Rebuild the existing-structure model from as-built drawings, site measurement and material tests, listing existing load, added load and capacity for every affected foundation and member; simulate each step of demolition, temporary support and added load in the model and measure strain and settlement of key columns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An existing building's foundation capacity is fixed at its original design value." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改造只以設計時的竣工圖推估既有容量，未發現歷次改造已增加的荷重，新增荷重可能使某些基礎超載而產生不均勻沉陷；拆除順序錯誤則可能讓營運中的樓層短暫失去支承。
knowledge.textEn: Estimating existing capacity only from original drawings, without discovering loads added by earlier alterations, can overload some foundations with the new load and cause uneven settlement; a wrong demolition sequence can briefly leave occupied floors without support.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Construction-stage analysis for alterations in occupied buildings" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要完工狀態的模型正確，施工順序不會影響構件內力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
